articles.summary: Jane Ma Joins as Managing Director in New York Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Jane Ma has joined as a Managing Director in its Financial Services Group. Based in New York, Ms. Ma’s coverage area primarily focuses on alternative asset managers, while also dedicating time to the wealth management services and asset/wealth technology sectors. Ms. Ma joins the firm after 16 years at Moelis Company, where she most recently served as a Managing Director covering the asset management, wealth management, and asset and wealth management technology sectors. articles.summary: Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, today announced that it will release its second quarter results for the 2027 fiscal year on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Houlihan Lokey will host a conference call at 5:00 p.m. (ET) that same day to review the results. On the call, Scott Adelson, Chief Executive Officer, and Lindsey Alley, Chief Financial Officer, will discuss the fiscal 2027 second quarter results and provide commentary on business performance. A question and answer session with analysts and investors will follow the prepared remarks. Access to the live conference call will be available via telephone or audio webcast. To Participate via Telephone Participants are advised to dial into the call at least 10 minutes prior in order to register. (NYSE:HLI) (“Houlihan Lokey” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for its second quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenues were $692 million, compared with $660 million for the second quarter ended September 30, 2025. Net income attributable to Houlihan Lokey, Inc. was $109 million, or $1.64 per diluted share, for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared with $111 million, or $1.63 per diluted share, for the second quarter ended September 30, 2025. articles.summary: Derek Herbert Joins as a Managing Director in Continued Expansion of Firm’s Direct Equity Product Team Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI), the global investment bank, announced today that Derek Herbert has joined the firm’s Capital Solutions Group as a Managing Director. Based in New York, Mr. Herbert will serve as a senior financial professional on the Equity Capital Solutions team, focused on leading direct equity transactions. Mr. Herbert joins from Stifel, where he was most recently a Managing Director in its Mergers Acquisitions Group. Previously, he held roles at Miller Buckfire, prior to its acquisition by Stifel, and in Morgan Stanley’s Investment Banking Division.
